case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You pointed to rising alloy and material costs, and we take that seriously. Our options answer it with a longer commitment: a contract term that gives Blankstahl Werdenfels planning security for its capacity.

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.79; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.84; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.81; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve: with costs moving this way, it gives you a longer contract term at a price that reflects them.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As the decision on price may not rest with you alone, we would be grateful if you would take Option A to the colleague who decides and ask for a yes.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our current offer is a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

For a 24-month contract term, we must include an AS-14404 index clause to manage material price volatility. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

We acknowledge the recent decreases in the AS-14404 and PPI-C2431 indices, which we have factored into our revised calculation. We are unable to provide an internal cost breakdown, but we are pleased to offer €5.50 per unit with your requested 45-day payment terms. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We always value our partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and love finding ways to support you with our extensive range and high-level service.

We note your proposal of a binding annual volume of 23,700 units; however, we request that you share the underlying consumption data or release schedules to verify this figure. Building on your preferred 45-day payment term and the prospect of this volume, we can adjust our price to €5.30 per unit, provided the index clause is included. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.

Please understand that a 24-month contract term strictly requires an AS-14404 index clause to responsibly manage material price volatility, making a fixed price unfeasible. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit. 

This proposal stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You asked which volume we can commit to, and whether an index clause can carry the material risk.

We have no index clause in these options, so the price is a firm one for the whole term and spares you the volatility you describe.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.03; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.98; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.00; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 23,700 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Blankstahl Werdenfels the highest unit price of the three, together with the binding volume for the full term.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As our solution for both family companies, we ask you to take Option A to the colleague who decides on pricing at your end, so that we can settle this quickly.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
